nodes.title: Manual Prompt
widgets_values: A close-up portrait of a pale bald fantasy creature sitting at a table in a warm indoor setting, drinking from a clear glass. In front of the character there is a bottle of Brazilian guaraná soda instead of vodka, with green branding, soft reflections, and a refreshing soft drink appearance. The mood remains intimate and slightly humorous, with warm lighting, realistic skin texture, detailed facial features, and the same composition unchanged.

If you bypass the second pass, it's advisable not to downscale the video. That is, setting this value to 1.0 or 0.5 means you're generating a video with half the specified size. Additionally, you need to adjust the subject that SAM3 will use in the second pass.

The quality of reference-based inpainting depends heavily on what you put in the prompt. You can describe the scene in a general way, but always with the new object included. Sometimes, a lack of detail will make the result turn out completely different. This can also happen, for example, when doing inpainting of a full person: if there is another person in the scene and you use a simple prompt, the model may try to use the person already present in the scene instead. That is why the prompt is so important, as well as the amount of space in the mask.
